title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: People Skills removal and deletion admin control
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft supports the deletion scope, administrator roles, timings, licensing and opt-in behaviour. The narrower policy's UI path stops early, and the export and audit checklist steps have no corresponding controls-table entries; these are minor findings.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The roadmap describes a new tenant-wide People Skills removal control for offboarding in support of governance and compliance.
claims.quote: A new admin control in the People Skills settings lets administrators permanently remove their organization's People Skills data from the tenant.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The removal control is admin-only.
claims.quote: The control is admin-only with no automatic changes.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationales
claims.claim: The removal control is admin-opt-in: its arrival causes no automatic change, and nothing is deleted unless an administrator uses it.
claims.quote: The control is admin-only with no automatic changes.
